title: A Homecoming for the Yearbook
author: Edmund Ishikawa
blurb: Orsen Nakamura, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before prom.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
